modules.title: Command Identity
modules.promise: Reframe the job: you are a solutions supplier for a programmer's clock, not a supplicant. Quantify the cost of silence and lock the No-Spam Oath.

lessons.title: The Unheard Tax — What Being Ignored Actually Costs You
lessons.truth: Every single release cycle without broadcast airplay imposes a compounding tax across your reach, direct revenue, and deal leverage. Silence is not neutral — it is an active expense.

lessons.title: Station-As-Customer — Radio Is a Market, Not a Favor
lessons.truth: You are not asking a Program Director for a favor. You are offering a commercial enterprise a precision product that solves their clock, audience retention, and regulatory compliance problems.

lessons.title: The Proof Stack — Build the Evidence Vault That Makes PDs Say Yes
lessons.truth: Nobody risks airtime on enthusiasm. The Proof Stack is your third-party credibility vault — transforming subjective musical taste into undeniable objective evidence.

lessons.title: The No-Spam Oath & Identity Shift — From Beggar to Frequency Owner
lessons.truth: The artists who own radio are the ones who behave like owners — precision, respect, and earned volume. The No-Spam Oath is the line that separates you from 99% of your competition.

modules.title: Target Architecture
modules.promise: Turn geography, tour dates, and format math into a 20-station war room with a defensible priority score for every row.

lessons.title: The Hometown Heat Map — Find the Stations That Can't Say No
lessons.truth: Your first 20 wins are a geography problem, not a music problem. The Hometown Heat Map concentrates your fire where proximity makes you commercially undeniable.

lessons.title: Tour Pre-Roll — Manufacture Airplay Demand With Dates
lessons.truth: A confirmed show date is the single most potent airplay catalyst in independent music — converting an abstract song submission into a time-stamped, ticket-selling community event.

lessons.title: The Format Scoring System — Rank Every Station Like an Analyst
lessons.truth: Format fit accounts for 50% of every programming rejection. Scoring stations with mathematical rigor prevents you from wasting A-tier pitches on zero-probability rooms.

lessons.title: The 20-Station War Room — Build the Command Center That Never Sleeps
lessons.truth: Dominion is concentration of force. A locked war room of 20 scored, personalized stations will produce 5x more adds than an undisciplined database of 500 names.

modules.title: The Pitch System
modules.promise: Build the 4-7 word subject line, the 90-word pitch, the one-page EPK, and radio-ready audio — one weapon, one ask.

lessons.title: Subject Lines That Cut Through Noise — The 30-Formula Vault
lessons.truth: A music director decides whether to open your submission in 1.4 seconds. Your subject line is not a creative headline — it is an operational routing code.

lessons.title: The 90-Word Pitch — The Only Email That Matters
lessons.truth: A music director reads your pitch for four seconds. The 90-word pitch is an operational payload — delivering maximum technical clarity, proof, and a single frictionless ask.

lessons.title: The One-Page EPK That Commands Attention
lessons.truth: Your Electronic Press Kit is not a promotional brochure — it is a single-screen Command Deck designed to give a gatekeeper all critical operational facts in 20 seconds.

lessons.title: Radio-Ready Audio — The 90-Second Weapon That Forces Replies
lessons.truth: A programmer does not have time to sit through a five-minute album cut. The 90-second audio weapon and compliant broadcast master remove every technical barrier between your music and their transmitter.

modules.title: The 21-Day Campaign
modules.promise: Run the dated 21-day loop: load, fire, watch, follow up with value, exit with grace, log every result.

lessons.title: The Load Sequence — Arm Every Station Before You Send
lessons.truth: The first email is not the launch — the Load Sequence is. A campaign executed without passing all seven pre-flight gates will collapse into chaotic improvisation.

lessons.title: First Sends — Timing, Waves, and the 4-Hour Rule
lessons.truth: When you dispatch a payload matters as much as what is inside it. Two waves, Tuesday/Wednesday morning timing, and the four-hour monitoring window dictate initial conversion.

lessons.title: The 3-Touch Follow-Up System — Persistence Without the Stench
lessons.truth: The first email is a knock on the door. The second is proof you are serious. The third is a dignified exit. Over 65% of all independent radio adds occur on Touch 2 and Touch 3.

lessons.title: Adds & Next-Market Expansion Loops — One Station Into a Cascade
lessons.truth: An add is not the finish line — it is a live seed. The Expansion Loop converts a single station victory into a domino cascade across neighboring regional markets.

modules.title: Human Frequency
modules.promise: Convert replies into relationships: high-value calls, gratitude protocols, burned-well repair, and the ally engine.

lessons.title: High-Value Calls — The 12-Minute Relationship Call
lessons.truth: One disciplined 12-minute phone conversation accomplishes more than twenty unread emails. The call is not a sales pitch — it is an elite relationship reconnaissance mission.

lessons.title: The Thank-You Economy — Tiny Gestures, Lifelong Allies
lessons.truth: The difference between a station that plays you once and a station that champions your entire ten-year career is what you do in the 48 hours after they add your song.

lessons.title: Burned-Well Repair — The 5-Step Protocol for Salvaged Relationships
lessons.truth: Every working artist has burned wells — past spam blasts, ghosted interviews, broken deadlines. The 5-Step Repair Protocol reopens doors you thought were locked forever.

lessons.title: Relationship Compounding — The 90-Day Ally Engine
lessons.truth: One radio add is a transaction. Thirty lifetime allies is an unbreachable commercial moat. The 90-Day Ally Engine compounds relationships on a calendar schedule that never sleeps.

modules.title: The Compounding Loop
modules.promise: Cascade proof into the next market, price your revenue lanes honestly, calendar the next release, and audit every 90 days.

lessons.title: Proof Compounding Systems — Turn Every Spin Into a Weapon
lessons.truth: Every broadcast spin is a verifiable intellectual property receipt; every receipt is ammunition; ammunition fuels the next release. The proof farm turns ephemeral airplay into permanent equity.

lessons.title: Airplay-to-Income — Convert Frequency Into Money
lessons.truth: Airplay is not vanity applause — it is an intellectual property validation receipt that unlocks six distinct revenue lanes. If you are not monetizing frequency, you are leaking wealth.

lessons.title: The Release Calendar That Dominates Quarters
lessons.truth: A release is not an isolated event — it is a 12-week military operation. The artists who own radio run an annual calendar with three armed campaigns a year, backwards-engineered from impact dates.

lessons.title: The 90-Day Audit & Ascension Engine — Scale to $1M
lessons.truth: What gets measured gets dominated. The 90-Day Audit is the executive instrument panel; the Ascension Engine scales a localized radio footprint into a seven-figure independent music enterprise.
